tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: [Tool directory] Use this when you need alternatives to a known AI agent tool, not launch directories. Pass slug, the tool identifier returned by search_tools (for example, dify), not a URL or directory domain. Returns the source tool slug and its recorded alternatives with GitHub stats for comparison.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: [Tool directory] Use this when checking the AgentoolRank review status of a tool you submitted via submit_tool. Requires submission_id and status_token from that submission; returns review status, queue position and listing URL when available. Not for launch-directory progress — that is my_progress.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: [Tool directory] Get details for one tool by slug (from search_tools): GitHub stats, capabilities, best-for, limitations and alternatives.

tools.name: my_progress
tools.description: [Launch directories] Use this after report_result or to resume a session; requires the Submit Kit key. Returns product_type, cap, sites, progress_page and counts: issued (total handed out), unreported, submitted, listed_reported, rejected, failed and skipped. Outstanding sites have status 'issued' in sites. Remaining allowance is cap minus issued, not a returned field or a guarantee of matching directories. Not for AgentoolRank listing review status — that is get_submission_status.

tools.name: next_directory
tools.description: [Launch directories] Use this when working through launch directories with a required Submit Kit key. Returns exactly one next directory when available; submit there, then call report_result. May return report_first or done instead. At most 3 unreported sites, up to 50 per key; product_type is bound on first issuance. For a free overview list, use recommend_directories.

product_type.description: Needed on the first call only

tools.name: recommend_directories
tools.description: [Launch directories] Use this when you need a free overview of the best-fit launch directories for a product_type: top 5, no key required, with conditions and submission steps. An optional valid Submit Kit key ($29) returns the full overview and directories to avoid. To work through the full list one directory at a time with a Submit Kit key, use next_directory instead.

languages.description: Directory languages to include, default ['en'] (also: zh, fr)

open_source.description: Include directories that only list open-source projects

key.description: Submit Kit key for the full list (optional)

tools.name: report_result
tools.description: [Launch directories] Use this when recording an outcome for a domain issued by next_directory, not submitting a tool to AgentoolRank. Requires the same Submit Kit key, that domain and status: submitted, listed, rejected, failed or skipped; listing_url and note are optional. Records the outcome and clears that site's unreported slot. Reporting 'listed' is only a lead: it counts toward listing rate only after our daily check finds it live.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: [Tool directory] Search open-source AI agent tools (frameworks, coding agents, memory, RAG, observability, MCP servers) ranked by GitHub activity. Returns stars, 30-day star growth, capabilities and alternatives.

query.description: What you need, e.g. 'multi-agent framework in TypeScript' or 'RAG'

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: [Tool directory] List an AI agent tool (framework, coding agent, MCP server, memory/RAG, evals, browser agent...) on AgentoolRank for free. The free listing is queued; the response lists every paid option (price, days to go live, checkout_url for your human to pay) and recommends the cheapest one that fits max_budget_usd / deadline_days. Returns submission_id + status_token for get_submission_status, and message_for_human: a summary to forward to your human.

email.description: Maker's email, used only to say when the listing is live

max_budget_usd.description: Optional: the most your human will pay

deadline_days.description: Optional: must be live within this many days
